mapper.insert: insert into sys_user(username, password, last_login_time) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{lastLoginTime})
mapper.update: update sys_user set password = #{password} where username = #{username}
update sys_user set last_login_time = #{lastLoginTime} where username = #{username}
update sys_user set status = #{status} where username = #{username}
update sys_user set role = #{role} where username = #{username}
update sys_user set is_deleted = 1 where username = #{username}
mapper.select: select * from sys_user where username = #{username} and is_deleted = 0
